title: Class 8 Mathematics Quiz
description: A 20-question multiple-choice quiz for Class 8 Mathematics, arranged under Remembering, Understanding, Applying, Analyzing, Evaluating and Creating.
instructions: The timer is set to 20 minutes and starts when you begin the quiz.
Your result will be calculated automatically after submission.

questions.text: What is the value of 2³?
How many sides does a quadrilateral have?
What is the additive inverse of a number?

options.B: The number with the opposite sign

questions.text: In the equation x + 5 = 12, which is the unknown quantity?
If the ratio of two numbers is 2:3, what does it mean?

options.A: The first number is twice the second
options.B: The first number is two-thirds of the second
options.C: The second number is half the first

questions.text: What is true about the opposite sides of a rectangle?

options.C: They are perpendicular to each other

questions.text: What does it mean when two fractions are equivalent?

options.D: Both their numerators and denominators are zero

questions.text: If the number of workers doing a fixed amount of work increases, what generally happens to the time required?
One book costs ₹50. What is the cost of 4 such books?
If 3x = 18, what is the value of x?
A rectangle is 8 cm long and 5 cm wide. What is its area?
Five pens cost ₹40. What is the cost of 10 pens at the same rate?
A vehicle travels 150 km in 3 hours. How far will it travel in 5 hours at the same speed?
Which pair of fractions is equivalent?
A quadrilateral has four angles, each measuring 90°. What type of quadrilateral is it?
The sum of two numbers is 30 and their difference is 10. What are the numbers?
When 5 is added to three times a number, the result is 20. What is the number?
Ramesh says that 2/3 + 1/3 = 3/6. Which evaluation is correct?

options.A: He is correct because numerators and denominators are added
options.B: He is incorrect; the correct sum is 1
options.C: He is correct because the denominators are equal
options.D: He is incorrect; the correct sum is 1/6

questions.text: A student says, “Every square is a rectangle.” Which evaluation is correct?

options.A: The statement is false because a square has four equal angles
options.B: The statement is true because a square has four right angles
options.C: The statement is false because all four sides of a square are equal
options.D: The statement is false because a square has no parallel sides

questions.text: You are planning a rectangular garden that is 12 m long and 8 m wide. How much fencing is needed to go all the way around it?
